title: registry.service_account.changed payload (v1)
description: INTEGRATION service account created/rotated/revoked; audited. Ids and changed field names only; no secrets or password data. Producer: registry. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-TEN-06, FR-AUD-02. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
